_doc: Analysis-stream configuration map: groups runs (seeds) into configurations for scripts/collect_results.py and scripts/analysis/build_manifests.py. role in {released, retrain, control, candidate, hparam, ablation, zeroshot, smoke, final, ensemble}; released/retrain are Test100 reproduction targets, everything else reaches Test100 only via results/PREREGISTRATION.md. slot = fixed figure colour (1 blue, 2 orange, 3 aqua, 4 yellow, 5 magenta, 6 green, 7 violet, 8 red; 0 = grey context).

mmp_hrnet_base.label: HRNet-W48 DARK 384 (MMPose control)
mmp_hrnet_base.what_changed: FiDIP backbone re-implemented in MMPose, no domain adaptation, shared recipe
mmp_hrnet_base.hypothesis: recipe-parity control for the backbone swap

mmp_vitl256_base.label: ViTPose-L 256 (MMPose)
mmp_vitl256_base.hypothesis: a stronger COCO-pretrained transformer prior localises infant joints better

mmp_hrnet_lr2e4.label: HRNet-W48 DARK 384, LR 2e-4
mmp_hrnet_lr2e4.hypothesis: the 1e-4 FiDIP LR is too low for the 30-epoch MMPose schedule

mmp_vitl256_lr2e4.label: ViTPose-L 256, LR 2e-4
mmp_vitl256_lr2e4.hypothesis: ViT fine-tuning benefits from a higher LR

rt_fidip.label: FiDIP retrain, lambda 5e-4
rt_fidip.what_changed: official recipe retrain (COCO DarkPose init, PRE_EPOCH 10, lambda 5e-4), Val400 epoch selection

rt_ft.label: Fine-tune retrain, lambda 0
rt_ft.what_changed: same recipe with lambda = 0 (no domain adaptation)

mmp_vitl256_lr5e5.label: ViTPose-L 256, LR 5e-5
mmp_vitl256_lr5e5.hypothesis: ViT fine-tuning prefers a lower LR

mmp_vith256_base.label: ViTPose-H 256 (MMPose)
mmp_vith256_base.hypothesis: a larger ViT prior helps further
mmp_vith256_base.outcome: selected as arm B (seed s1; supplementary, imp-4)

mmp_vith384_base.label: ViTPose-H 384 (MMPose)
mmp_vith384_base.hypothesis: higher input resolution helps the strict OKS thresholds

mmp_vitl384_base.label: ViTPose-L 384 (MMPose)
mmp_vitl384_base.hypothesis: higher input resolution helps the strict OKS thresholds

mmp_hrnet_lr5e5.label: HRNet-W48 DARK 384, LR 5e-5
mmp_hrnet_lr5e5.hypothesis: lower LR preserves the COCO prior

mmp_vitl256_realonly.label: ViTPose-L 256, real only
mmp_vitl256_realonly.what_changed: train on the 200 real images only (no synthetic)

mmp_vitl256_rot180.label: ViTPose-L 256, rotation +-180 deg
mmp_vitl256_rot180.hypothesis: infants appear at any in-plane angle

rt_ft_attempt1.label: Fine-tune retrain, attempt 1
rt_ft_attempt1.outcome: failed: yacs type error (LAMBDA float vs int); resubmitted

arm_a.label: HRNet-W48 DARK 384 (arm A)
arm_a.ckptrule: best Val400 coco/AP epoch per seed

arm_b.label: ViTPose-H 256 (arm B)
arm_b.what_changed: pre-registered treatment: backbone ViTPose-H 256x192, same recipe as arm A, 5 fresh seeds s2-s6
arm_b.hypothesis: H1: Test100 AP > 93.6 and C1 CI excludes 0 under both protocols
arm_b.ckptrule: best Val400 coco/AP epoch per seed

zs_darkpose.label: DarkPose HRNet-W48 (COCO only, released)
zs_darkpose.what_changed: upstream TGA_models coco/w48_384x288.pth, no SyRIP fine-tuning (upstream test code)
zs_darkpose.hypothesis: reproduces the published DarkPose 88.5 on Test100

rt_ftnp.label: Plain fine-tune retrain (no pre-stage, lambda 0)
rt_ftnp.what_changed: PRE_EPOCH 0 and lambda 0.0: no classifier pre-stage, no adversarial term (repro-3)
rt_ftnp.hypothesis: faithful counterpart of the paper's DarkPose+Finetune 92.7 row; FiDIP > plain fine-tune

rt_paperrecipe.label: FiDIP retrain, paper recipe
rt_paperrecipe.what_changed: paper recipe: Adam lr 1e-3, 100 epochs, batch 64, lambda 5e-4 (1 seed)
rt_paperrecipe.hypothesis: the paper's recipe (not the released yaml) explains the published numbers
rt_paperrecipe.outcome: no gain: best Val400 at epoch 10, then overfits

rt_readme_labels.label: FiDIP retrain, README-literal labels
rt_readme_labels.what_changed: train on syrip_for_train.zip train_infant.json (MINI-RGBD labels on the synthetic images), 1 seed
rt_readme_labels.hypothesis: the README's training labels cost accuracy

mmp_vith256_realonly.label: ViTPose-H 256, real only
mmp_vith256_realonly.what_changed: train on the 200 real images only (no synthetic), ViTPose-H 256
mmp_vith256_realonly.hypothesis: synthetic SyRIP images still help the selected backbone
